# Y7 Logistics — Licensed & Bonded FMCSA Auto Transport Broker

> Y7 Logistics (Y7 Consulting Inc) is a Licensed & Bonded FMCSA freight broker
> (MC #1741537, USDOT #4427359) based in Natick, MA. We connect shippers with
> vetted, insured motor carriers for nationwide auto transport across all 50 US
> states — auction pickups (Copart, IAA, Manheim), dealer trades, port and
> export deliveries, and private vehicle relocations. Y7 is a broker, not a
> carrier: carriers haul and hold cargo insurance; Y7 arranges and oversees the
> move under a $75,000 BMC-84 surety bond. Pricing uses a separate dispatch fee
> for each vehicle, with the carrier's rate shown on a signed dispatch sheet — no spread, no
> hidden markup. Dealers pay $50 per vehicle, or $60 when Y7 handles carrier
> payment. Exporters pay $50 per vehicle with carrier-payment handling included
> and have no $60 tier. Individuals pay $75 or 10% of the carrier price,
> whichever is greater. The carrier rate is always separate from the Y7 fee. Y7 also
> prepares and files Certificates of Origin for US-built vehicles exported to
> the EU. The site is published in English, Polish (/pl), Ukrainian (/ua) and
> Russian (/ru).

## Core services
- [Y7 Logistics home](https://www.y7agency.com/): Home page: who Y7 serves (dealers, exporters, private shippers), the dispatch-fee model, and the quote widgets.
- [Auto Transport Services](https://www.y7agency.com/services): Full overview of Y7's brokered auto transport for shippers, dealers, and exporters.
- [Ship My Car](https://www.y7agency.com/ship-my-car): Door-to-door car shipping for individuals relocating or buying a vehicle out of state.
- [For Dealers](https://www.y7agency.com/dealers): Volume auto transport for dealers — auction pickups, dealer trades, and consolidated invoicing.
- [For Exporters](https://www.y7agency.com/exporters): Inland delivery to US ports with gate-pass and documentation coordination for overseas buyers.
- [Certificate of Origin](https://www.y7agency.com/certificate-of-origin): Y7 prepares and files a Certificate of Origin (issued as an eCO) for US-built vehicles exported to the EU, where US-origin vehicles qualify for 0% import duty under EU Regulation 2026/1455. Price: $99 per certificate for established exporter clients, $150 one-off; issued within 7 business days. A standalone service — no transport booking required. Available in Polish, Ukrainian and Russian (see International).
- [Car Shipping Cost](https://www.y7agency.com/car-shipping-cost): How auto transport pricing works and what drives the quote on a given lane.
- [Open Car Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/open-car-shipping): Standard open-trailer transport — the most common and economical option.
- [Enclosed Car Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/enclosed-car-shipping): Covered-trailer transport for luxury, classic, and high-value vehicles.
- [Salvage Car Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/salvage-car-shipping): Transport for non-running, damaged, and salvage-title vehicles.
- [State to State Car Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/state-to-state-car-shipping): Interstate auto transport across all 50 states.

## Get a quote, track a shipment
- [Get a Quote](https://www.y7agency.com/quote): The quote form. Enter pickup and delivery ZIP codes, vehicle and contact details; Y7 replies within one hour during business hours with a carrier rate plus its flat dispatch fee, no obligation. Available in Polish (/pl/quote), Ukrainian (/ua/quote) and Russian (/ru/quote).
- [Dealer Account Review](https://www.y7agency.com/dealer-quote): Application form for licensed dealers and exporters who want a Y7 account: volume, lanes, preferred ports and payment option; Y7 responds within one business day.
- [Track a Shipment](https://www.y7agency.com/track): Shipment status lookup by Y7 reference number or VIN — pickup, delivery and carrier details for an active order. Available in Polish, Ukrainian and Russian (/pl/track, /ua/track, /ru/track).

## Routes
- [Massachusetts to Florida](https://www.y7agency.com/massachusetts-to-florida-car-shipping): Northeast-to-Florida snowbird and relocation lane.
- [New Jersey to Florida](https://www.y7agency.com/new-jersey-to-florida-car-shipping): NJ-to-Florida auto transport lane.
- [Texas to Port Newark](https://www.y7agency.com/texas-to-newark-port-auto-transport): Inland Texas to Port Newark export corridor.
- [Chicago to Port Newark](https://www.y7agency.com/chicago-to-port-newark-car-shipping): Midwest-to-Port-Newark export corridor.
- [Atlanta to Port Savannah](https://www.y7agency.com/atlanta-to-savannah-port-auto-transport): Atlanta-area Copart, IAA and Manheim pickups delivered to the Garden City Terminal in Savannah, with gate-pass coordination.
- [Dallas to Port Houston](https://www.y7agency.com/dallas-to-port-houston-auto-transport): Dallas-area Copart and IAA pickups delivered to Port Houston warehouses; typically $300 to $500 carrier rate.
- [Florida Auctions to JAXPORT](https://www.y7agency.com/florida-to-jacksonville-port-car-shipping): Florida Copart and IAA yards to Jacksonville for RoRo and container export; $250 to $500 intra-Florida floors.
